The Lost Boys of Bird Island- fact or fiction

By: Liz Fish | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

Unique Selling Point:
The Lost Boys of Bird Island was punted as an expose of the shocking heart of the National Party. The dark secrets of a pedophile ring involving Magnus Malan, John Wiley and businessman and police reservist Dave Allen. Tafelberg Publishers astonishingly sold this book as fact but in the months that followed its launch it seems it would have been wiser to find it in their fiction category. This insert will reveal why.

Summary:
The sensational novel about a pedophile ring of former cabinet minister flying young boys to Bird Island off Port Elizabeth in the 1980’s made headlines late last year. The book reveals that defence minister Magnus Malan and former environmental affairs minister John Wiley‚ were involved in child sex orgies‚ along with former police reservist and businessman Dave Allen. It was an old story that had made the rounds in the 80’s but was never substantiated. This book was marketed as factual- a shocking expose by the policemen who investigated the case and the investigative journalist who had covered it but had been muzzle by the oppressive regime. Then a few days after the book hit the shelves Mark Minnie was found dead. Immediately Chris Steyn and the publishers suspected it was a throwback of third force hit squad of the 80’s who wanted to silence him from revealing more. When they found the suicide note Chris Steyn insisted it was an assisted suicide, not unlike the “assisted” suicides of Dave Allen and John Wiley much of which Chris Steyn tries to prove in the book.

Further information:
Private investigator Wouter De Swardt and forensic investigator David Klatzou where hired by the Foundation for Human Rights and the family to investigate Minnie’s death and if there was evidence of a pedophile ring. They quickly established that in fact it was suicide. Minnie had used a former girlfriend’s laptop - Melanie Sheppard, leaving access to his email account. She found the suicide note as well as evidence that he had searched how to commit suicide by hanging as well as in which direction a gun needed to be fired to successfully execute himself. Klatzou left PE within days but Wouter stayed to investigate further unravelling critical flaws and filing a report that discredited Steyn and Minnie and revealed no evidence that could substantiate Malan and Du Plessis or Wiley in pedophilia
A copy of the laptop was handed to the Foundation of Human Rights which Wouter never fully trawled as he was removed from the investigation a few weeks in. Investigative journalist Jacque Pauw who made a damming critique of the book is now in procession of the laptop – probably acquired from the former girlfriend. What it reveals is that 3 days prior to Mark Minnie’s suicide he wrote to Marianne Thamm, Chris Steyn and the publisher that he was worried that there was not sufficient evidence that Magnus Malan, Barend Du Plessis and Mark Wiley were involved in acts of pedophilia. They ignored it and launched the book never the less. Minnie took his life days later. Pauw has the email.
Also on the laptop are 3 versions of the book. The first he sent to his wife in 2016, then a second and third version to the publisher but key facts change with each version and the story gets more elaborate. Wouter reveals Minnie was fired from the police force; he was never the glorified undercover cop and led a life of crime fleeing the country after a diamond deal went bad. On the laptop is Minnie own biography in which he details his life of crime. It also reveals falsified copies of a BA degree, a fake qualification to teach English. He never held down the honorable teaching profession.
William Hart is the one witness still alive but as an alcoholic and living on the streets his version won’t stand up in court. However he is an extremely literate and clever man despite his disease. But one critical thing that will stand up to court is his age, he was 24 when he had sex with Allen and that does not make Allen a pedophile. Hart also says he never went to Bird Island in a helicopter but dived coral with Allen and there never were any other “Uncles” around when they had sex.
Astonishingly Jacque told all this information to Eloise Wessels the CEO of NB Publishers who has chosen to ignore this information and has not come out an made a public apology either to the families of Malan, Wiley or to Barend Du Plessis who is the only accused still alive. Former air force pilot Brig Gen Rodney Penhall who flew all flights to Bird Island from 1985 to 1988 states he never saw any children ever on the flights, never mind bleeding to death having been shot up the rectum. He also points out all flights have to have a minimum crew of 3 and ground crew so there are plenty more witnesses out there. None have stepped into the open to date.
Why is Chris Steyn sticking to her guns- the books are selling like hot cakes, she has a share in the royalties for the movie and she can sell her next novel which she promises will reveal more


Extra Budget Items:
Derek Liz and Wouter will have to fly in on Sunday evening to PE as Monday we will have to film 4 key interviews and links and on different locations. Barend Du Plessis lives in Pretoria and deserves the right of reply and the Pilot also lives in Pretoria both have critical factual information. These interview will have to be done by a separate crew. We may well need an extra day in PE as he major part of the story is set in PE. If Chris Steyn does do the interview she lives in Hermanus which is a two hour trip both ways and Jacque Pauw lives in Riebeeck Wes. There is a strong possibility we may need 3 days with the presenter considering the logistics.

Script: It was a story that shocked South Africa, and reverberated around the world when it was released in August last year
Link The lost boys of Bird Island is billed as a shocking expose of a violent paedophile ring involving national party ministers and young coloured boys in the eighties. It rocked the country as the latest dark secret to be revealed from the apartheid era
Script: It alleged an appalling abuse of power – power that extended to Minister of Defence General Magnus Malan, Finance Minister Barend du Plessis – although he wasn’t named in the book – and Environment Minister John Wiley they supposedly commanded a South African Air Force helicopter to fly them and their under-age victims to Bird Island,
It was Co-authored by Mark Minnie, former narcotics policeman in Port Elizabeth and investigative journalist Chris Steyn. Jacques Pauw author of The Presidents Keepers has been very outspoken about the book
Pauw “And when I read the book I realized that there is not a hell of a lot of evidence in the book and I found it astonishing that the authors for example. Doesn't use the words alleged or according to our evidence or people have been telling us that they stated as a fact.
Script: The paedophile ring was said to be orchestrated by one man – police reservist and businessman Davis Allen who had a guano concession on Bird island. Then David Allen committed suicide. Or was he murdered? Then John Wiley committed suicide. Or was he murdered?
Script: And then another shock 8 days after the book hit the shelves Mark Minnie was found dead, a gunshot wound to his head. It was an apparent suicide, but was it really? Was it in fact a third murder by agents of the old apartheid regime, staged to look like a suicide
Script: Private Investigator Wouter de Swardt was commissioned by the Foundation for Human Rights to investigate the death as well as the alleged peodopohile ring. Wouter worked closely with Chris Steyn investigating all the possible leads
Wouter UP “ This is the path he followed with the rope over his shoulder then entered the hot house over here his intention was to throw the rope over one of these installation here there were workers inside which is not normally the case on a Monday morning but for some reason they were early that morning so he turned around and went back to the house. A few minutes later they heard a gunshot. Minnie also did extensive researches on how to commit suicide using a weapon
Derek Up sound “ Now Chris Steyn says the findings were inconclusive
Wouter: Derek that is simply not correct because the pathology report says self inflicted based on the gunpowder etc my forensic report based on the gunshot wound etc says he did it himself so how can that be inconclusive
Script: private investigator Mark Jansen Van Rensburg was critical to Wouters investigation. He had worked with Minnie in the 80s and seen him the weekend before he took his life.
Derek: How did you know Mark Minnie
JVR”I've met him in the 80s when he was part of the narcotics unit in Port Elizabeth. A hard worker, a hard drinker,a hard player. At the time excellent policeman thereafter when you got involved with the unsavory characters, people that would go and steal and rob people there was an incident in Klerksdorp where they took diamonds from the Nell brothers worth in millions and soon there after Mark disappeared
Link “ Minnie starts the book with an interview with a young boy in hospital terrified and suffering from severe anal injuries. His statement describes group sex in a flat implicating a Port Elizabeth diver Dave Allen and the Minister of Defence Magnus Malan
Script: Pauw discovered that there were 3 versions of the book on Minnie laptop after he died
Pauw “Probably the most important event in the book is The Confession of Allen. When Minnie takes him to the police station after they arrested him for pornography and sexual abuse in the first version of the book he makes no confession. In fact Mark many says he was quiet. He didn't want to say anything in the second version he names one person John Wiley and then suddenly in the book he sang like a canary. He said he wasn't going to go down on his own and he mentioned John Wiley Magnus Malan and then the third minister who was identified afterwards as Barend Du Plessis
Link: We asked NB Publishers and the co- author of the book Chris Steyn for their side of the story she hasn’t responded to numerous emails and phone calls and the publishers would only respond to our questions in writing
Quote ”At the time of publication and still today, NB Publishers regard the information contained in the book as credible and of public interest …. We were always aware of the difficulty in not having access to documentary evidence contained in the docket, which was unlawfully removed from Minnie’s possession… We strongly deny that NB Publishers fabricated any information or facts presented in the book. Minnie was directly involved in the police investigation and Steyn spoke to at least 25 sources
Script: Jansen Van Rensburg had accessed Minnie emails during the investigation, revealing that the authors, the publisher and journalists worked together AFTER the book went on sale to find proof of the allegations made in the book.. On the eve of his suicide he wrote “I'm not ready to do radio shows just yet because there some ex- military guys have posted on social media that they're attempting to establish my whereabouts. They believe for the time being that I'm in China and I'm busy assisting with an investigation into the blue Combi and a house in Witelsbos.”

Link: 20 34 03 Link: This raises two important issues. Why after 30 years was he not ready to answer questions about the investigation? And why were they still looking for concrete evidence after the book had been published
Script: The publishers say it’s because the docket was stolen, and he didn’t want to reveal he was in the country. But given Minnie’s alleged shady criminal connections there were a lot of people looking for him


Script: Wouter interviewed one of Minnie’s main witnesses “A young boy called William Hartt”, who had allegedly identified Malan and Wiley. Wouter gave him the book and asked him to comment on its accuracy. William was angry about how much his story was distorted.
Link: We tracked down William Hart who has been living on the streets of Port Elizabeth for the past 30 years and asked him about the allegations made in the book by Mark Minnie. He wanted his identity hidden.
Derek: Were you ever on bird island.
William No. Never. Never in my life. You know how old I was when Dave got Bird Island
Derek How old were you in 1987.
William “ Twenty seven twenty six.
Derek” Not a boy.
Pauw “He was under 18 in the middle 70s when not neither Magnus Malan Barend Du Plessis or John Wiley were even minister
Derek “Did you ever meet Magnus Malan personally.
William. “He was the minister of defense. Everybody knew him.
Derek “ What about John Wiley. I don't know him,
Script :The Publishers say “William Hart has changed his version in some respects”
Pauw “ William tells Mark Minnie how he was taken to Bird Island and how the sexual abuse took place on bird island and then in the third book it all becomes Witelsebos.
Script: Witelsenbos became the key link that Steyn and Minnie made implicating the third Minister but 5 days after the book was published they were still looking for evidence. This email was sent from the editor to Minnie and Steyn
“If Mr X or some of the victims can identify the house and we can confirm the house belonged/still belongs to BdP by doing a deed search, then it points the finger directly at him.”
Link: This is the holiday home of Barend du Plessis, the third minister implicated in the paedophile ring. It's near Witelsbos about 150 km from Port Elizabeth where the alleged abuse of young boys took place.
Du Plessis “Well you know the past eight months are the worst eight months of my life.
Script: Barend Du Plessis was Minister of Finance from 1984 to 1992 serving at the same time as Magnus Malan and John Wiley
And throughout my entire life I've never had a leaning towards that vicious kind of crime. And all of a sudden to be hit, on the front page with my former colleague, that I am guilty of a crime that I've never even given some thought to in my life about the existence of it
Derek “Where you ever at bird island
Du Plessis”My secretary she said to me that she'd received an invitation from the Office of late Minister John Wiley inviting me to the opening of a new quay. Because Bird Island is a place where guano is harvested there would be a little bit of an occasion to two fish as well. And I'm crazy about fishing And that was the only time in my whole life. That I visited bird island.
Derek Were there any boys transported with you in the helicopter
Derek “Did you ever meet this man called William in the book.
De Plessis “ No never never my visits to Port Elizabeth were few in the sense that I made a speech on one or two occasions. And that is all. I have never been in social circles in Port Elizabeth at all.
Link: Since the death of Mark Minnie, the police have investigated the possibility of a pedophile ring involving apartheid ministers during the 80s. So you might expect that the only living minister implicated in this abuse would have been questioned.
Derek”Have you been interviewed by police
. No. I will welcome that. Because then it will force an issue to a point where it can stop. Hovering above me like the darkest butt that anybody could wish for.
Script The Wiley family have lived under a similar butt for the last 30 years. They investigated Wiley suicide and the peodpile allegation thoroughly when the story was first hit the press in Playboy Magazine, the article was later retracted. Wiley visited Bird Island three times, accompanied by fisheries officials on two occasion and on the fishing trip with Barend and Malan.
Jacque [20:55:37] Despite the police investigation and this is a big police investigation there were eight cops in Port Elizabeth last week looking at the case the cops. Have not found any evidence to link. Any of the cabinet ministers to the sexual abuse of boys.
Script: Pauw revealed everything he had found out about Minnie to the publishers 6 months ago. He told them of Minnie’s criminal past, and faked certificates of qualification. He noted that Chris Steyn’s ex-husband was Lieutenant Colonel Eeben Barlow, was a former operative of the Civil Co-operation Bureau the apartheid death squads.
JVR: The last interview the last phone call I received from Chris Steyn Mark do you do you believe I killed Mark Minnie I said no Chrissie the book killed Mark Minnie
Script: the Publishers and Steyn distanced themselves from Wouter and sought to discredited him once he informed them they had no factual basis for the allegations against the Ministers. Despite this Wouer like Steyn, continue to follow every lead
Wouter:I am a cop when it comes to my work. I'm apolitical. Believe me if I've found any evidence whatsoever. That either of the gentlemen or anyone else in this in this story was involved in pedophilia I would hang them on the post myself.
Pauw: A it is clear when you look at the e-mails that he had reservations about the book he told the publishers we have no concrete evidence and yet they went to ahead
Script: NB Publishers stands by the book and its authors.
Barendt:I find extremely difficult to understand is how people can get away with that kind of thing for so long
Promo 11 • The Lost Boys of Bird Island” was as an expose of the paedophile rings in the former National Party, but how much was reaching beyond the available evidence
Promo 11“The sensational book about a paedophile ring of cabinet ministers flying young boys to Bird Island in the 1980s made headlines last year. But what was fact and how much was fiction?
Promo 11 “ Did “The Lost Boys of Bird Island” reveal the dark secrets of a paedophile ring among National Party ministers and businessmen, or were they fictional events that never happened?

metadata.Unique Selling Point: The Lost Boys of Bird Island was punted as an expose of the shocking heart of the National Party. The dark secrets of a pedophile ring involving Magnus Malan, John Wiley and businessman and police reservist Dave Allen. Tafelberg Publishers astonishingly sold this book as fact but in the months that followed its launch it seems it would have been wiser to find it in their fiction category. This insert will reveal why.
metadata.Summary: The sensational novel about a pedophile ring of former cabinet minister flying young boys to Bird Island off Port Elizabeth in the 1980’s made headlines late last year. The book reveals that defence minister Magnus Malan and former environmental affairs minister John Wiley‚ were involved in child sex orgies‚ along with former police reservist and businessman Dave Allen. It was an old story that had made the rounds in the 80’s but was never substantiated. This book was marketed as factual- a shocking expose by the policemen who investigated the case and the investigative journalist who had covered it but had been muzzle by the oppressive regime. Then a few days after the book hit the shelves Mark Minnie was found dead. Immediately Chris Steyn and the publishers suspected it was a throwback of third force hit squad of the 80’s who wanted to silence him from revealing more. When they found the suicide note Chris Steyn insisted it was an assisted suicide, not unlike the “assisted” suicides of Dave Allen and John Wiley much of which Chris Steyn tries to prove in the book.
metadata.Further information: Private investigator Wouter De Swardt and forensic investigator David Klatzou where hired by the Foundation for Human Rights and the family to investigate Minnie’s death and if there was evidence of a pedophile ring. They quickly established that in fact it was suicide. Minnie had used a former girlfriend’s laptop - Melanie Sheppard, leaving access to his email account. She found the suicide note as well as evidence that he had searched how to commit suicide by hanging as well as in which direction a gun needed to be fired to successfully execute himself. Klatzou left PE within days but Wouter stayed to investigate further unravelling critical flaws and filing a report that discredited Steyn and Minnie and revealed no evidence that could substantiate Malan and Du Plessis or Wiley in pedophilia A copy of the laptop was handed to the Foundation of Human Rights which Wouter never fully trawled as he was removed from the investigation a few weeks in. Investigative journalist Jacque Pauw who made a damming critique of the book is now in procession of the laptop – probably acquired from the former girlfriend. What it reveals is that 3 days prior to Mark Minnie’s suicide he wrote to Marianne Thamm, Chris Steyn and the publisher that he was worried that there was not sufficient evidence that Magnus Malan, Barend Du Plessis and Mark Wiley were involved in acts of pedophilia. They ignored it and launched the book never the less. Minnie took his life days later. Pauw has the email. Also on the laptop are 3 versions of the book. The first he sent to his wife in 2016, then a second and third version to the publisher but key facts change with each version and the story gets more elaborate. Wouter reveals Minnie was fired from the police force; he was never the glorified undercover cop and led a life of crime fleeing the country after a diamond deal went bad. On the laptop is Minnie own biography in which he details his life of crime. It also reveals falsified copies of a BA degree, a fake qualification to teach English. He never held down the honorable teaching profession. William Hart is the one witness still alive but as an alcoholic and living on the streets his version won’t stand up in court. However he is an extremely literate and clever man despite his disease. But one critical thing that will stand up to court is his age, he was 24 when he had sex with Allen and that does not make Allen a pedophile. Hart also says he never went to Bird Island in a helicopter but dived coral with Allen and there never were any other “Uncles” around when they had sex. Astonishingly Jacque told all this information to Eloise Wessels the CEO of NB Publishers who has chosen to ignore this information and has not come out an made a public apology either to the families of Malan, Wiley or to Barend Du Plessis who is the only accused still alive. Former air force pilot Brig Gen Rodney Penhall who flew all flights to Bird Island from 1985 to 1988 states he never saw any children ever on the flights, never mind bleeding to death having been shot up the rectum. He also points out all flights have to have a minimum crew of 3 and ground crew so there are plenty more witnesses out there. None have stepped into the open to date. Why is Chris Steyn sticking to her guns- the books are selling like hot cakes, she has a share in the royalties for the movie and she can sell her next novel which she promises will reveal more
